meta.question: U6: model and channel cost per practitioner per month, under explicitly labelled assumptions about conversation volume

labels.SOURCE: read from a dated primary source in this session
labels.SECONDARY: taken from research/ (search summaries of primary pages, not the pages themselves)
labels.ASSUMPTION: Co-Pilot assumption, no measurement behind it; to be replaced by pilot or practitioner data
labels.OWNER: Owner statement or estimate, not measured

model_prices.label: SOURCE
model_prices.unit: USD per million tokens, Claude API first-party standard rates
model_prices.note: Candidate tiers only; model choice is undecided (brief section 7). Non-Anthropic providers not priced: their pricing pages were blocked by the session proxy.
model_prices.tokenizer_factor_note: SOURCE (same page): Claude 4.7 and later models use a tokenizer producing approximately 30% more tokens for the same text; exact increase depends on content. Token counts below are stated in the older tokenizer (Haiku 4.5) and multiplied by this factor. Russian-text ratio not measured.

telegram_bot_api_per_message.label: SECONDARY
telegram_bot_api_per_message.basis: research/CHANNEL-POLICY-CHECK-2026-09-22.md section 3: Bot API free at MVP volumes; core.telegram.org blocked again on 2026-09-22

telegram_business_monthly.label: ASSUMPTION
telegram_business_monthly.basis: Only if the bot replies AS the practitioner's own account (Telegram Business). Gating behind a paid Premium subscription is unverified (research section 3); $5 is an assumed list-price order of magnitude, regional prices not checked.

whatsapp_utility_template.label: SECONDARY + ASSUMPTION
whatsapp_utility_template.basis: research section 2: illustrative ~$0.01 utility (rate card for UA/KZ not read); low/high are assumed bounds. Comparison only.

whatsapp_service_reply.label: ASSUMPTION
whatsapp_service_reply.basis: research section 2: service replies reported free now and reported to become billable from 2026-10-01 with no rate found. Non-zero values are hypothetical sensitivity points, not rates.

price_points.basis: 79/149/219: AI Beauty Bot tiers (SECONDARY, research/COMPETITOR-SCAN-2026-09-22.md, unconfirmed on vendor page). 400/500: Owner price assumption A2 (OWNER). Reference points, not a chosen price.

visits_per_month.label: ASSUMPTION
visits_per_month.why: solo practitioner, ~3-8 procedures per working day, ~20 working days

dialogs_per_visit.label: ASSUMPTION
dialogs_per_visit.why: booking, rescheduling, reminder replies, aftercare questions and inquiries that never book, per booked visit

client_msgs_per_dialog.label: ASSUMPTION
client_msgs_per_dialog.why: client messages that each trigger one agent reply

tool_calls_per_dialog.label: ASSUMPTION
tool_calls_per_dialog.why: calendar lookups / booking writes, each an extra model round trip

escalation_share.label: ASSUMPTION
escalation_share.why: dialogs handed to the practitioner with a model-written summary (clinical questions, complaints, exceptions)

reminders_per_visit.label: ASSUMPTION
reminders_per_visit.why: deterministic template reminders; no model call assumed

system_tokens.label: ASSUMPTION
system_tokens.why: role, practitioner voice, rules, disclosure and escalation policy

kb_tokens.label: ASSUMPTION
kb_tokens.why: practitioner knowledge base in the prompt: services, prices, preparation/aftercare, policies, FAQ

tools_tokens.label: ASSUMPTION
tools_tokens.why: tool definitions plus tool-use system prompt (the latter is 354-588 tokens per the pricing page)

card_tokens.label: ASSUMPTION
card_tokens.why: client card injected into each call

exchange_tokens.label: ASSUMPTION
exchange_tokens.why: one client message plus one agent reply, Russian text

tool_result_tokens.label: ASSUMPTION
tool_result_tokens.why: calendar slots or booking confirmation returned to the model

output_tokens_per_reply.label: ASSUMPTION
output_tokens_per_reply.why: visible reply plus any reasoning tokens, all billed as output

aux_instruction_tokens.label: ASSUMPTION
aux_instruction_tokens.why: short instruction for card-update and escalation-summary calls (no knowledge base)

cache_hit_rate.label: ASSUMPTION
cache_hit_rate.why: 1-hour cache on the practitioner's static prefix (system + KB + tools), shared across all their dialogs; misses are billed as 1h writes

onboarding_one_off.label: ASSUMPTION
onboarding_one_off.why: brief interview with the practitioner and knowledge-base assembly, once per practitioner; reported separately, not monthly
